n, k = map(int, input().split())

mod = 10**9 + 7

def pw(x, p, M):
    r = 1
    while p > 0:
        if p % 2 == 1:
            r = (r * x) % M
        x = (x * x) % M
        p //= 2
    return r

if k == 0:
    print(pw(n, n - 1, mod))
    exit()

class DSU:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.r = [1] * n
        self.p = list(range(n))
    
    def par(self, i):
        if self.p[i] != i:
            self.p[i] = self.par(self.p[i])
        return self.p[i]
    
    def unite(self, i, j):
        i = self.par(i)
        j = self.par(j)
        if i == j:
            return
        if self.r[i] < self.r[j]:
            i, j = j, i
        self.p[j] = i
        self.r[i] += self.r[j]

d = DSU(n)

for i in range(n):
    d.unite(i, (i * k) % n)

ans = 1
for i in range(n):
    if d.par(i) != i:
        continue
    t = pw(k, d.r[d.par(i)], n)
    if t == 1:
        ans = (ans * n) % mod

print(ans)
